observations.image_loading: STB imread converts RGB file bytes to BGR; PIXEL_BGR2RGB reverses to RGB
observations.resize: read_and_resize_image calls from_pixels_resize for [800,448,3]; mat_pixel.cpp bypasses interpolation when dimensions match
observations.normalisation: ncnn2table uses supplied float32 norm; native preprocess uses 1/255 for each RGB channel
observations.eq: quantize_EQ indexes input arrays by channel j and image list by layer i inside loops whose intended indices are jj and ii; suspect out-of-bounds access
observations.weights: Convolution int8 weights use one scale for each output channel
observations.activations: Convolution ARM forward uses bottom_blob_int8_scales[0] across channels; no per-block mode used
observations.winograd_weight_range: Stock KL/ACIQ assigns scale 31/absmax, signed 6-bit weights, to 3x3 stride-1 dilation-1 convolutions for int8 Winograd F43; other Convolution scales use 127/absmax. Both remain per-output-channel.
